radar.justification: Apache-2.0 spec and SDKs, public repository and Discussions; governance favors Google.
Any domain can publish a profile, but Google holds proxy votes until December 2028 and the domain, and one platform dominates live use.
Four dated releases and a live Google deployment; frequent breaking changes and drafts on main.
Live US checkout on Google surfaces, named national retailers and many endorsers, but only an order-of-magnitude merchant figure from Google and no volume figures.
Buyer places the order in a trusted UI unless the AP2 extension is active, and AP2 live use is unverified.
Order adjustments record disputes and refunds; resolution stays with merchant and card rules.

controlsCells.note: Platform profile URL in UCP-Agent with RFC 9421 signatures against its keys, or API key, OAuth or mTLS bound to that profile.
Permissionless by design; businesses should keep a registry of pre-approved platforms. No know-your-agent registry.
Buyer places the order in a trusted UI unless AP2 is active; buyer_consent map; AP2 checkout_mandate as signed consent.
No cap field; limits live in AP2 mandates, the credential provider or the platform.
Tokens are handler-specific and some (Adyen) are bound to session and merchant; AP2 mandates bind the merchant-signed checkout.
Checkout expires_at defaults to 6 hours; mandate_expired in the AP2 extension.
Remove keys from the profile; RFC 7009 token revocation required for identity linking; OpenID RISC recommended.
requires_escalation handoff through continue_url; 3DS2 device data collection and challenge actions in the optional authentication extension.
Signed Idempotency-Key with 128-bit entropy, 24 to 48 hour storage and 409 on mismatch; Web Bot Auth shape adds nonce.
Order with permalink_url and a required confirmation email; AP2 mandates kept as JCS-canonical evidence.
Order adjustments can record disputes, refunds and returns; dispute handling stays with the business and PSP.
No reputation mechanism for platforms or businesses.
signals such as dev.ucp.buyer_ip and dev.ucp.user_agent, plus signed order webhooks.
